technique_name: List the five biggest startups in India.
description: The five biggest startups in India are Flipkart, Ola, Paytm, Oyo, and Grofers. Flipkart is an e-commerce platform, Ola is a ridesharing service, Paytm is an e-commerce payment system, Oyo is an hospitality company, and Grofers is a grocery delivery service.
